title: Eclipthar`s Xaero Force Block Plugin
description: Adds a server-side verification system to enforce the no minimap/map rule
body:
**_REQUIRES THE MOD VERSION ON PLAYER CLIENTS : [CLICK HERE](https://modrinth.com/mod/eclipthars-xaero-force-block-mod)_**

Adds a server-side verification system to enforce the no minimap/map rule by actively checking connected clients and preventing the use of any minimap or map-related modifications. This ensures fair gameplay by blocking unauthorized map features and maintaining consistent rule enforcement across the server.
